title: ... but can it play DOOM? (In Business Central)

chapters.title: DOOM engine ported to AL code
Data storage in tables and Doom AL code structure
JavaScript rendering and frame rate limitations
Doom gameplay demo with frame rate metrics
Code modifications and cheating in Doom
Second cheat implementation and damage immunity
C2AL tool for translating C code to AL
Direct code translation and AL output

features.name: DOOM page user control
features.description: A page in Business Central built as a user control host that loads and renders the DOOM game, allowing players to play DOOM shareware, registered version, and DOOM 2 directly within Business Central.
caveats: Requires WAD files embedded in the extension
Performance varies depending on system resources

features.name: Pure Doom engine translated to AL
features.description: The Pure Doom portable game engine was translated line-for-line and function-for-function into AL code, resulting in approximately 45,321 lines of AL code implementing the full game logic and rendering.
caveats: Contains 45,321 lines of AL code
Functionality dependent on external tools for translation

features.name: JavaScript-based rendering and input handling
features.description: A JavaScript component manages frame rendering via WebGL, music playback using SpinSynth with MIDI soundfont, user input capture (keyboard and mouse), and supports CRT emulation filters for authentic Doom visual rendering.
caveats: Less than 530 lines of JavaScript code
Requires WebGL support in browser
Music conversion between MUS and MIDI formats needed
Frame rate limited to around 10 frames per second
Latency in round trip between JavaScript and Business Central is the primary performance bottleneck
May require improvements to Microsoft's infrastructure for better performance

features.name: WAD file storage in tables
features.description: DOOM WAD files containing game assets, maps, sprites, and sound are deserialized and stored in the Doom Bad Lump table (table ID 666), making all game resources available within Business Central tables.
caveats: Requires full WAD file embedded in application
Table structure designed specifically for DOOM asset format

features.name: Save game persistence
features.description: Game progress can be saved and retrieved, with save games stored in Business Central tables using a usage category approach, allowing players to save state under custom names like 'YouTube'.
caveats: Save game format dependent on AL table structure

features.name: Code modification during runtime
features.description: Developers can modify AL source code and publish changes quickly, demonstrated by changing the A_FirePistol function to fire plasma missiles instead of bullets, with publish taking just a couple of seconds.
caveats: Deploy from page editor sometimes triggers on open page event multiple times

features.name: C2AL code translation tool
features.description: A tool built to automatically translate C code into AL code for Business Central, addressing the challenge of porting large amounts of C code. It uses the Sick C compiler parser and a Python-based tool to convert C code through an intermediary format to AL.
caveats: Only works reliably when C code has minimal dependencies
Requires a custom header file to handle standard library functionality
Generated code should not be edited by hand
Working with AIs for translation breaks at scale
Works best with minimal dependencies
Memory manipulation in C results in unusual looking AL code using integer lists to represent memory
Optimization of generated code is not yet a priority
